projects.projectName: Vivli - AI Form Check Validation & Agentic Chat Automation

Risks.riskTitle: Contractual Ambiguity and Legal Exposure from Undocumented 7-Week Timeline Extension
Risks.riskDescription: Project timeline extends 7 weeks beyond the contract end date (September 11, 2026 to October 30, 2026) without formal contract amendment, change order, or documented extension approval. Go-Live is scheduled 4-5 weeks post-contract, and Hypercare extends 6-7 weeks beyond contract term, creating critical legal, financial, and governance exposure.

Risks.riskTitle: Critical Client Dependency Bottlenecks Blocking Sprint 5 and PAT Readiness
Risks.riskDescription: Four high-severity dependencies on Vivli team remain unresolved as of Week 11 of 16, some open for 2-4 weeks. These dependencies block critical path activities including Sprint 5 scope (escalation workflow, admin access, RBAC), PAT readiness, and production deployment preparation. Historical pattern shows client environment and approval delays caused Sprint 1 slippage and continue to compress delivery timelines.

Risks.riskTitle: PAT Defect Discovery Risk Requiring Additional Development Time Beyond Sprint 5
Risks.riskDescription: The 15-day formal PAT period (August 31 - September 18, 2026) may reveal critical defects requiring additional development sprints, but no contingency time exists between PAT end and Code Freeze (same date: September 18). Historical pattern shows PAT early access reviews consistently generate significant bug backlogs and enhancement requests that feed into subsequent sprints. Current bug list shows 53 work items with UI issues and in-flight functionality defects, indicating quality concerns.

Risks.riskTitle: Sprint 5 Scope Overload Risk: Insufficient Capacity for Bug Fixes, Enhancements, and Critical Features
Risks.riskDescription: Sprint 5 (August 17-31, 2026) is loaded with bug fixes from PAT feedback, enhancement requests, critical integration work (escalation workflow, RBAC, admin access), DevOps IaC sign-off, and GPT-5 Mini migration. This represents 8+ major work streams in a 2-week sprint while also addressing accumulated bug backlog of 53 items. Historical pattern shows feedback-driven scope expansion and sprint compression. Risk of incomplete Sprint 5 delivery impacting PAT readiness.

Risks.riskTitle: Resource Availability and Commitment Risk Beyond Contract End Date
Risks.riskDescription: Project requires both Ascendion and Vivli team resources through October 30, 2026 (Hypercare end), but contract ends September 11, 2026. No documented resource commitments exist for the 7-week extension period. Risk of resource reallocation, availability conflicts, knowledge loss, or reduced engagement during critical PAT, Regression, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.

Risks.riskTitle: Scope Creep via Enhancement Classification and Evolving Requirements
Risks.riskDescription: Some issues are being classified as 'enhancements' rather than bugs, and Sprint 5 includes 'enhancement feedback' from PAT reviews. Chat-based escalation requirements are still being refined in Sprint 4 (Week 11), and Guru Card fit assessment remains in progress. No clear change control process is documented for distinguishing enhancements from core scope. Risk of scope expansion beyond contract without formal approval, increasing cost and timeline pressure.

Risks.riskTitle: Regression Testing Defect Discovery Requiring Go-Live Delay
Risks.riskDescription: The 15-day Regression testing period (September 21 - October 9, 2026) occurs entirely post-contract and immediately precedes Go-Live (October 10-16). Any critical defects discovered during Regression will require code changes, retesting, and potential Go-Live delay. No contingency buffer exists between Regression end (October 9) and Go-Live start (October 10). Historical pattern shows testing phases were underestimated and extended (R01).
